location: Office Hub - Santa Barbara / Office Hub - Dallas, TX / Office Hub - San Diego, CA United States
description:
AppFolio is more than a company. We’re a community of dreamers, big thinkers, problem solvers, active listeners, and multipliers. At every opportunity, we set the pace while delivering innovation built to carry real estate into the future. One in which every experience feels effortless, yet meaningful. Where customers are empowered to take on any opportunity. We show up as one team, connected by our values to be a force for good. Because together, we have the power to create extraordinary outcomes for our customers, our communities, and ourselves.



The Sr. Manager of Customer Success, Strategic will onboard, lead, and develop our growing team of elite Strategic Customer Success Managers (SCSMs), who partner with our top 150 accounts to help sophisticated operators perform at the highest level as AppFolio powers the future of the real estate industry. This leader thinks critically, is comfortable operating in ambiguity, and is a driver who gets results. You will set a clear standard for what great looks like, clear obstacles so SCSMs can focus on customer outcomes, and work across Product, Technical Account Management, Sales, Care, and RevOps on the team's behalf.


YOUR IMPACT

 - Onboard, lead, coach, and develop a growing team of Strategic CSMs through 1:1s, portfolio and account reviews, and live coaching that build business acumen, discovery skills, and executive presence.

 - Define and reinforce what great looks like for an SCSM: a strategic advisor who ties platform adoption to each customer’s business results, supported by a structured account assessment (readiness, health, strategic alignment, and adoption) and consistent rhythms for Joint Success Plans, Business Reviews, and renewal forecasting.

 - Coach SCSMs to build credible value stories that quantify customer outcomes and connect platform adoption to key operational metrics such as NOI, occupancy, and revenue.

 - Guide SCSMs to connect AI-powered capabilities, including the Realm-X suite, to each customer’s business goals and measure the value delivered, working alongside TAMs on adoption.

 - Own portfolio outcomes across our top 150 accounts in retention, expansion (via CSQL), adoption, and advocacy while accurately forecasting renewals and risk.

 - Eliminate operational roadblocks by identifying escalation patterns, resolving root causes, and keeping SCSMs focused on high-value customer initiatives.

 - Leverage AI and data to scale team impact across account preparation, health monitoring, coaching rhythms, and workflow efficiency.

 - Represent customer insight cross-functionally across Product, Technical Account Management, Sales, Care, and RevOps to resolve systemic roadblocks and influence product direction.

 - Drive long-term Strategic Customer Success strategy and operational rigor, steering high-stakes executive relationships and multi-year retention outcomes.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Proven ability to coach, develop, and inspire experienced, high-performing customer success professionals in a high-growth environment.

 - Critical thinker skilled in isolating root causes from symptoms and navigating high-complexity, unprecedented challenges.

 - High comfort operating in ambiguity, with a history of defining new operational standards and driving cross-functional change.

 - Driver with a track record of consistently meeting commitments and delivering retention and expansion results.

 - Strong executive presence with demonstrated capability to lead high-stakes negotiations with senior leaders and enterprise stakeholders.

 - Builds trusted, productive relationships across functions and influences without authority to get results with partners in Product, Technical Account Management, Sales, Care, and RevOps.

 - Broad and deep expertise in Customer Success, with a current view of where the discipline is heading and how it connects to AppFolio’s business and the competitive landscape in real estate technology.

 - Curiosity and practical fluency in leveraging AI tools to transform team workflows and productivity.

 - Elevating the collective output of the department by modeling cultural values and holding leaders accountable.


MUST HAVE

 - 8+ years in customer success, account management, or a related role, including 5+ years leading teams with experienced, senior individual contributors, preferably in Enterprise SaaS or Real Estate Technology.

 - Documented track record of retaining and expanding strategic, relationship-driven accounts, managing enterprise account health, and forecasting renewals.

 - Proven ability to operate effectively within a matrixed organization and lead teams through change.

 - Technical Proficiency with Customer Success platforms (e.g., Vitally), enterprise CRMs (Salesforce), Google Suite, and generative AI platforms.

 - Willingness to travel about 20 to 25% for client visits, team meetings, and industry events

 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical professional experience

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
About Smartcat 
 Smartcat is building the future of work, where human expertise meets digital teammates to drive 10x to 1000x productivity gains for the world’s leading enterprises.
 We’re on the frontier of an entirely new category: Agentic AI. We enable enterprises to build high-performing hybrid workforces made up of both humans and AI agents. These AI agents aren’t generic copilots. They’re fully trained digital teammates that learn from your best people, your content, and your business strategy—ready to get to work from day one.
 Our platform combines generative AI, human-in-the-loop workflows, and a living Enterprise Skill Graph that continuously learns and improves. Whether you're launching a product globally, onboarding new hires, translating learning content, or aligning legal teams across regions, Smartcat turns knowledge into action and action into scale.
 Over 1,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Smartcat to bring their business to the world—instantly, accurately, and in every language. As a Series C company with strong year-over-year growth, we’re scaling fast and investing in people who want to shape the future of work with us.
 Join us in unlocking global potential, one human and agent team at a time.
 WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN OUR TEAM 
 You’ll join a newly formed Technical Account Management team built to make sure every Smartcat customer, at every tier, can reach a human technical expert. AI already resolves a growing share of customer issues, so you’ll own the escalations beyond what AI can handle: technical troubleshooting, integrations, and workflow questions, solved in an AI-forward way. You’ll be assigned a portfolio of accounts, and on our largest accounts you’ll be the named technical resource and work directly with the account executive.
 MISSION 
 Be the trusted technical expert behind Smartcat ’s customers: meet their needs with passion and approachability, resolve complex escalations with AI-first problem solving, keep integrations and workflows healthy, and give customers around the world fast, expert technical support at any hour.
 OUTCOMES 
 Act as the technical point of contact for an assigned portfolio of accounts within your tier (Strategic, Enterprise, or Corporate), partnering with the account team on each
 Take ownership of customer escalations that go beyond what Smartcat ’s AI capabilities can resolve, using technical troubleshooting and AI tools to reach resolution quickly
 Resolve customer inquiries and requests in modern ticketing systems such as Zendesk and YouTrack, maintaining a consistently high customer satisfaction rate
 Provide 24/7 coverage as part of a globally distributed team, so every customer can reach a human regardless of tier
 Own technical onboarding and implementation: API and connector integrations (CMS, TMS, DAM, dev tools), SSO/SAML setup, workspace architecture, and workflow configuration
 Escalate feature requests, bugs, and issues that need engineering to Support, Product, and Engineering with clear reproduction steps, and own root-cause communication through resolution
 Advise customers on best-practice use of Smartcat ’s platform (CAT tools, AI Coworkers, Marketplace, PDF pipeline, custom workflows) to maximize adoption and ROI
 Monitor technical health signals (integration failures, API error rates, usage drop-offs) and flag risk to the account team before it becomes churn
 Collaborate with engineers, analysts, testers, success managers, and product managers, and relay customer technical feedback to influence the roadmap
 Develop and maintain help center content, internal documentation, runbooks, and reusable integration patterns, using AI to keep them current
 Support renewal and expansion conversations with technical proof points: performance data, integration health, and use-case expansion opportunities
 How the tiers differ: On Strategic accounts (our largest named customers), you’ll be the go-to technical resource and work directly with the assigned account executive. On Enterprise and Corporate accounts, you’ll cover a larger number of accounts, with less day-to-day customer-facing time and more emphasis on efficient, AI-powered issue resolution.
 HOW YOU’LL RAMP 
 By Day 30:
 Learn Smartcat ’s platform end to end: CAT tools, AI Coworkers, Marketplace, PDF pipeline, custom workflows, and the integration and API landscape
 Learn how AI handles first-line customer issues today, where human escalation takes over, and how tickets flow through Zendesk and YouTrack
 Meet your account team, Support, Product, and Engineering counterparts, and get oriented on your assigned accounts: architecture, integrations, open issues, and health signals

ABOUT GENERATION 
 At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Generation trains and places adult learners of all ages into careers that are otherwise inaccessible, working in partnership with governments, employers, and other system actors. We also conduct original research and share data insights on high-priority global workforce transition topics to inform decision-making by workforce system stakeholders. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. To date, the network has 150,000+ graduates and 23,000+ employers across 50 professions and 17 countries.
 When learners join Generation, 91% are unemployed, of which nearly half are long-term unemployed. Three months after completing our program, graduates have a 78% job placement rate, rising to 88% within six months. Of our employed graduates, 79% are hired by repeat employers who have previously hired Generation graduates, and 89% are in jobs directly related to the profession for which we have trained them. Employed graduates immediately earn an average of 3-4X their previous earnings. Two to five years after graduation, 77% of our alumni from upper-middle income countries continue to meet their daily financial needs and 63% can save for the future. To date, Generation’s global graduates have earned more than $1.9 billion in wages. Generation graduates typically have a secondary school background, 52% are female, 28% have dependents, and the majority identify with underrepresented communities in their country.

Fueled by passion for the social sector, and enabled by a growth mindset with personal responsibility, you will work to identify and cultivate the opportunities that enable economic mobility for our learners.
 Generation US targets for programming include connecting every graduate to at least one job interview and 80% post-program employment.
